Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite-family REDRAW for this EXACT attached game character. The supplied image is the authoritative actual in-game guard, NOT optional inspiration. Preserve EXACT same face, head-to-body proportions, head size, hairstyle, bun, nose, cheeks, torso width, short sturdy legs, costume cut, skin, shoes and accessories. She must remain recognizably this SAME MAGOLITA, not a taller/slimmer realistic woman. Do not beautify or redesign her.
MAGOLITA: brown hair in compact round rear bun and side-parted front hair, warm round face and large expressive eyes; blue short-sleeve collared work shirt, light dusty blue apron with white waist tie and visible rear white bow, dark navy work trousers, PURPLE RUBBER GLOVES always on, black rounded work shoes. No mop or objects.
ONE PNG exactly1536x3072, 3 COLUMNS x 6 ROWS, EIGHTEEN distinct full-body sprites in invisible512x512 cells. Exactly one pose per cell, never touching, margins>=20px. ALL sprites face RIGHT in three-quarter arcade view, chest slightly toward camera. Fixed SAME anatomical scale throughout ALL SIX ROWS and poses. Body about350px tall, feet at localy480 (absolute baselines480,992,1504,2016,2528,3040). Hair top around localy130; arms can rise above head without shrinking body. Preserve squat reference anatomy/head ratio rather than using realistic adult proportions. Feet stay at baseline. Same hip axis centered in each cell.
Clean RICH authentic arcade sprite pixel art matching the supplied reference's finish and detail. Crisp dark outline, shaped pixel clusters, controlled 3-5 cel tones/material, enough subtle warm skin and blue fabric shades to preserve the face and folds. No coarse posterization, no grain, noisy dither or isolated speckled pixels, no blurred/antialiased edges or gradients. Uniform fine pixel detail, not giant4x4 blocks. Do not make vector clipart. Use a cohesive shared palette for whole sheet.
Pure flat chroma GREEN #00FF00 outside silhouettes ONLY. No green within character. No shadows, floor, scenery, effects, speedlines, aura, props, text, numbers, labels, panels, frames, grid or watermark.
ROWS in precise order:
ROW1 ENTRANCE WALK then NEUTRAL: LEFT midstride right leg forward arms counter-swing, MIDDLE opposite midstride left leg forward, RIGHT stopped neutral stance knees relaxed arms down. This row must look IDENTICAL in head/body/costume scale and identity to all emote rows.
ROW2 SIX SEVEN: LEFT palms up right hand chest high left hand hip low; MIDDLE both palms up level at stomach shrug; RIGHT palms up opposite hand heights, left chest high right hip low. Subtle cheeky head tilt.
ROW3 BOAT PADDLE: LEFT empty hands together forward/down to RIGHT with torso twist; MIDDLE hands together center chest chin up calm; RIGHT hands together down toward LEFT opposite torso twist. No paddle/boat.
ROW4 MEWING: LEFT arms down chin raised closed lips; MIDDLE right index finger at jaw corner under ear, head right profile chin raised; RIGHT right index at chin, left hand on hip smug camera stare. Gloves retained.
ROW5 CHEN CHUPAS: LEFT rightward crossing step arms loose; MIDDLE swagger leaning back fist rising; RIGHT upright empty fist before mouth as imaginary microphone, other arm extended sideways, eyes closed head back. No microphone.
ROW6 SIGMA FINISH: LEFT arms crossed chin down zero-emotion stare camera; MIDDLE arms still crossed head turned away right; RIGHT one index pointing UP, other hand chest, feet wide, chin up proud victory. Raised pointing hand within cell above head; BODY SAME SIZE as every other row.
Only this ONE character, no duplicate types, no changes of costume or head shape.
